description: Replaced only the inverse-panel alpha-beta GEMM with CUTLASS's no-source persistent C=A*B kernel, retaining the 256x256 2-CTA/2x1 geometry, TMA output store, transposed inverse layout, and 4096-row direct-TRSM crossover. This removes the unconditional beta=0 C load warp/pipeline and raises A/B staging. Wrapped build, validation, fresh-input guard, and full grid passed. Aggregate reached a new branch best 743.614 us. n8192 measured 4452.950 us; affected n16384/n32768 improved from 13204.582/40535.527 to 13104.504/39794.560 us, saving 100.078/740.967 us. The Modal client timed out only while waiting for final app logs after the complete passing result block; the wrapped command exited zero.
Combining retained changes

Made the profile-guided solve shape-selective: n8192 retains direct cuBLAS TRSM plus FP16 conversion, while n16384/n32768 use one inverse TRSM followed by full-grid TMA/2-CTA-WGMMA solve and fused FP32/FP16 emission. Wrapped build, all official tests, fresh-input guard, and the full grid passed. Aggregate reached a new branch best 745.689 us versus parent 756.996. n8192 recovered from 5168.696 to 4462.002 us; n16384/n32768 further measured 13923.219/41395.458 us versus 13974.036/42320.194 in the all-inverse trial. No additional hosted request was used.

Combined the winning no-source/TMA-store inverse-panel solve with a 2x2 cluster, adding two-way panel-operand multicast while retaining the 256x256 2-CTA tile and 4096-row direct-tail crossover. Wrapped build, validation, fresh-input guard, and full grid passed. Aggregate measured 745.818 us. n8192 measured 4462.401 us; n16384/n32768 regressed from the no-source 2x1 cluster's 13104.504/39794.560 to 13363.446/40813.927 us, adding 258.942/1019.367 us.

Reconfirmed the identical shape-selective source from Trial30 on a normalized Modal sample after its n32768 outlier. Wrapped build, validation, fresh-input guard, and full grid passed again. Aggregate measured 748.273 us; n8192/n16384/n32768 measured 4461.794/13164.685/39943.051 us with ordinary variance. This removes the 41520.603-us outlier artifact, while the single-output variants still provide the strongest isolated cell measurements: FP32 n16384 13104.504 us and direct-FP16 n32768 39697.641 us.

Trial 3: corrected the dual epilogue by TMA-storing FP32 into the disjoint physical-upper output while directly storing packed FP16 factor-stack fragments, added a fused direct-tail transpose/conversion, and finalized diagonal factors plus lower zeroing in one persistent pass. Slice build, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and all 15 cells passed. Aggregate measured 748.558 us; n8192/n16384/n32768 measured 4465.102/13530.267/42033.620 us versus parent 4453.474/13112.407/39697.641.

Retested the no-source/TMA-store 256x256 solve with a 2x2 multicast cluster and corrected its persistent cap from 74 to 37 clusters, mapping one wave to the B200's 148 SMs. Wrapped build, validation, fresh-input guard, and full grid passed. Aggregate measured 748.769 us. n8192 measured 4459.094 us; n16384/n32768 regressed from the 2x1 no-source trial's 13104.504/39794.560 to 13692.432/42983.502 us. The corrected cap was slower than both the 2x1 winner and the earlier oversubscribed 2x2 sample.

Narrowed only the inverse-panel solve GEMM's output-column tile from 256 to 128 while retaining its 256-row 2-CTA geometry, occupancy-one staging, and the 4096-row direct-tail crossover. Wrapped build, validation, fresh-input guard, and full grid passed. Aggregate measured 751.139 us, helped by faster unrelated cells in this sample. Direct n8192 measured 4462.515 us; affected n16384/n32768 measured 13544.137/43954.889 us versus 13204.582/40535.527 with the 256-column tile, adding 339.555/3419.362 us.

Combined the no-source/TMA-store solve with a 256x128 2-CTA tile and 2x2 cluster: the cluster keeps a 256x256 output footprint, multicasts panel A across the N pair, and permits deeper A/B staging. The 4096-row direct-tail policy stayed unchanged. Wrapped build, validation, fresh-input guard, and full grid passed. Aggregate measured 751.141 us. n8192 measured 4465.086 us; n16384/n32768 regressed from the 256x256/2x1 no-source trial's 13104.504/39794.560 to 13678.080/42222.976 us, adding 573.576/2428.416 us.

Applied tcgen05-compatible 128-byte stage-offset padding to the rectangular source kernel's MN_SW64 D buffers: each compact per-stage layout is extended with an explicit stride of its codomain plus 32 FP32 elements, retaining three 128-column accumulator stages, cooperative two-CTA operand staging, exact rectangular coverage, direct-input graph semantics, and every other dispatch. Slice build, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and all 15 cells passed. Aggregate measured a brief-low 751.496 us versus unpadded Trial0 767.806 and parent 749.009. Batch2/n4096 measured 1786.401 us with one 11.940-ms outlier, 1724.416 us best, and about 1735.4 us excluding the outlier; unpadded measured 1835.222 with a 23.622-ms outlier, 1719.792 best, and about 1725.7 us excluding the outlier. The sole hosted slot was already consumed by exact unpadded Trial0, whose profile exposed the store conflicts that motivated this legal padding; no forbidden second request ran.

Expanded the winning no-source 256x256 2-CTA solve to a 4x1 cluster, capped at 37 clusters for one 148-SM wave, so two cooperative MMA groups multicast inverse-B tiles across the M dimension. TMA output store and the 4096-row direct-tail crossover were preserved. Wrapped build, validation, fresh-input guard, and full grid passed. Aggregate measured 754.715 us. n16384/n32768 regressed from 13104.504/39794.560 to 13772.768/43723.741 us, adding 668.264/3929.181 us; n8192 measured 4472.738 us.

Removed the intermediate FP32 solve workspace: the winning no-source 256x256/2x1 GEMM now TMA-stores solved panels directly into the persistent FP16 factor stack, then PyTorch expands that stack once into the strided FP32 output. This removes one full FP32 panel write/read pair and allows deeper solve staging. Wrapped build, validation, fresh-input guard, and full grid passed, confirming FP16 off-diagonal output remains within tolerance. Aggregate measured 755.188 us amid unrelated noise. n8192 measured 4453.671 us; n16384/n32768 measured 13236.157/40477.783 us versus the FP32-workspace no-source winner's 13104.504/39794.560 us, leaving 131.653/683.223 us to the half-to-float expansion path.

Replaced packed-column n64 storage with four full LD65 row-padded tiles in a 66.6-KiB dynamic-shared 256-thread CTA. This halves the parent grid to 256 CTAs while preserving its scalar coalesced I/O, register rows, two barriers per pivot, 32-bit offsets, and caller queue; total launched warps stay unchanged. Wrapped build, tests, guard, and full grid passed. n64 measured 21.223 us versus Trial2's two-matrix 20.947 and packed-four Trial3's 47.680, showing four-way CTA grouping is nearly neutral when regular addressing is preserved but the doubled shared footprint costs 0.276 us. n32 held 16.396 us. Aggregate reached 756.996 us, the branch-best, with favorable untouched n512/n4096 sampling and an n2048 clean floor of 1499.952 us.

Explicitly launched the retained two-matrix n64 kernel on the caller's current CUDA queue, completing explicit caller-ordering coverage across the three specialized small-shape paths. Wrapped build, all 17 official tests, fresh-input guard, and the full active benchmark grid passed. n64 measured 20.970 us versus Trial20's 20.898 us, while n32/n128 measured 16.428/53.275 us. Aggregate measured 757.269 us versus Trial20's 758.257 and the 757.741 parent, with all larger-shape paths unchanged.

Changed only the inverse-panel full-grid solve GEMM from a 256x256 to a 128x256 2-CTA tile, retaining the measured direct-TRSM policy for 4096-row tails. Wrapped build, official tests, fresh-input guard, and the full grid passed. Aggregate measured 757.752 us. n8192/n16384/n32768 measured 4474.154/13487.888/41683.634 us versus the 256x256 policy's 4459.888/13204.582/40535.527 us, so the finer row tile added 14.266/283.306/1148.107 us at those affected cells.

Narrowed only the winning no-source/TMA-store solve's N tile from 256 to 128 in the original 2x1 cluster, increasing output-column parallelism and A/B staging without reintroducing C traffic. Wrapped build, validation, fresh-input guard, and full grid passed. Aggregate measured 757.935 us. n8192 measured 4462.213 us; affected n16384/n32768 regressed from 13104.504/39794.560 to 13508.768/43768.626 us, adding 404.264/3974.066 us.

Profile-guided replacement of each huge cuBLAS panel TRSM with a 4096x4096 identity solve that materializes L^-T once, followed by a full-grid FP32 SM100 TMA/2-CTA-WGMMA panel GEMM. A fused emitter writes the solved FP32 panel and persistent FP16 factor stack in one pass. Build, validation, fresh-input guard, and full grid passed. Aggregate measured 758.115 us. n32768 improved dramatically from the partial-seed explicit parent's 52439.110 to 42320.194 us and n16384 improved 14249.811 to 13974.036 us; n8192 regressed from 4467.246 to 5168.696 us, motivating shape-selective retention of direct TRSM. No additional hosted profile request was used.

Specialized the compact n128 winner back to a true one-matrix kernel: removed paired-grid mapping, group arithmetic, active branches, unused second-tile addressing, and batch arguments; pass compile-time true through factor/solve/update helpers; explicitly 32-byte-align the 36-KiB shared block-tile store; retain 448 threads, fourteen WMMA warps, CTA barriers, and packed float4 I/O. Wrapped build, tests, guard, and full grid passed. n128 reached 53.134 us, improving Trial18's 54.121 by 0.987 us, Trial15's 55.092 by 1.958 us, and the dense parent by 3.027 us. n32/n64 reached 16.338/20.898 us. Aggregate measured 758.257 us, near the 757.741 parent despite an n2048 tail, with all larger winners unchanged.

Restored full n32 grid occupancy while retaining four-matrix CTAs, then specialized triangular I/O as aligned float4 row chunks, used 32-bit matrix offsets, restored the size-specific fast-rsqrt pivot, and launched on the caller queue. Wholly upper input chunks are skipped while diagonal-crossing chunks are masked in padded shared memory; output drains remain dense float4. Wrapped build, tests, guard, and full grid passed. n32 reached 16.396 us versus 17.317 for the 876-CTA persistent form and the prior retained 16.6-16.8 us range, showing vector I/O pays only when all matrix work remains concurrently scheduled. Aggregate measured 758.724 us, close to the 757.741 parent amid n2048 tails, with clean floors preserved throughout larger paths.

Widened the compact one-matrix n128 CTA from 448/14 to 512/16 threads/warps under native CTA barriers, retaining 36-KiB block-tile storage and all packed I/O/math. Wrapped build, tests, guard, and full grid passed. n128 measured 54.415 us versus the 448-thread Trial18 winner's 54.121, so the two additional WMMA warps regressed 0.294 us despite more solve coverage; fourteen warps' exact two-tiles-each first update remains preferable. n32/n64 measured branch-best-like 16.342/20.888 us. Aggregate reached 758.745 us with favorable untouched cells and n2048 tails.

Specialized each physical stage's update-only nodes at fixed depths one, two, and three, allowing Numba to inline constant panel coordinates and unroll the short LD72 rank-k sequence instead of carrying a runtime tile argument and loop through the graph. Solve nodes and exact 720/480/240 grids remain unchanged. Wrapped build, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and full grid passed. Batch60/n1024 improved from Trial1 917.209 mean/893.056 floor to 906.202/890.752 us; aggregate improved from 760.020 to 759.444 us.

Corrected the dense-FP16 left-looking 4096-wide supernode control by fusing complete upper-tile clearing into final diagonal-factor emission. Each later panel is now reconstructed once with one cublasGemmEx over the persistent prior-factor stack instead of repeatedly updating every trailing matrix. Official validation, fresh-input guard, and full grid passed. Aggregate measured 759.998 us; affected n8192/n16384/n32768 measured 4461.754/14236.803/51084.202 us. The result validates the left-looking memory geometry and shows the earlier failures were solely stale diagonal-supernode upper tiles.

Moved the exact batch lower-copy launch inside the cached batch60/n1024 CUDA graph, so each timed call now issues one graph replay instead of a separate copy launch followed by replay while still reading the caller's current stable input pointer. Wrapped build, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and all 15 cells passed. Target improved from Trial0 934.512 mean/901.344 floor to 917.209/893.056 us despite one 4842.304 us outlier; aggregate improved from 777.933 to 760.020 us, narrowly below parent Trial0's 760.688 aggregate.

Removed the policy-comment token from Trial4 and fully exercised two-warp 16-byte cp.async staging for both solve-only LD68 operands. Wrapped build, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and full grid passed. Batch60/n1024 measured 913.599 us mean/896.832 floor versus Trial2 906.202/890.752, and aggregate measured 760.655 versus Trial2 759.444; all-thread scalar factor staging remains lower measured. This is the fixed counterpart to Trial4's logged validation failure.

Replaced the direct-FP16 solve path's generic PyTorch half-to-float copy with a vectorized CUDA expansion that loads four half2 pairs and stores two float4 vectors per work item. The no-source GEMM still writes directly to the persistent FP16 factor stack with no FP32 solve workspace. Wrapped build, validation, fresh-input guard, and full grid passed. Aggregate measured 761.030 us due unrelated noisy cells. n8192 measured 4453.474 us; n16384 improved from 13236.157 to 13112.407 us, only 7.903 us behind the FP32-workspace no-source trial, while n32768 improved from 40477.783 to 39697.641 us, 96.919 us faster than that prior branch best.

Changed paired n128 scheduling from 128 all-pair CTAs to a mixed 148-CTA grid matching the B200 SM count: 108 CTAs factor two matrices and 40 factor one, distributing the same 4096 useful warps across every SM. Inactive second groups now skip factor/solve/WMMA math while participating in CTA barriers. Wrapped build, tests, guard, and full grid passed. n128 improved from 64.033 to 62.667 us, quantifying the 20 previously idle SMs, but remained 6.506 us above the 56.161 one-matrix parent because single-matrix blocks still reserve 1024 threads/128 KiB and paired groups share one barrier timeline. n32/n64 were 16.471/20.936 us; aggregate measured 762.192 us with larger-shape clean floors preserved.

Returned to the 448-thread compact n128 winner and replaced its now-single-group named barrier with native CTA synchronization; also restored n32's dense float4 drain and empty output cache after Trial17. Wrapped build, tests, guard, and full grid passed. n128 improved from named-barrier Trial15's 55.092 to 54.121 us, 2.040 us below Trial2's 56.161 dense parent; the CTA barrier avoids immediate-count named-barrier overhead once no sibling matrix needs decoupling. n32 reached a branch-best 16.357 us and n64 measured 20.912 us. Aggregate was 762.328 us with clean larger-shape floors and outlier-inflated n256/n2048 means.

Fused initial worker0's late diagonal drain, solved U01 panel drain, and FP16 sidecar packing into one float4/half2 C device pass. The worker now uses one CTA barrier and one address phase instead of separate factor and panel helpers; workers1-2 retain their panel-only path. Wrapped build, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and all 15 cells passed. Batch64/n256 improved from Trial4 75.043 us mean/66.220 best to 69.452/66.162, with one 0.696 ms sample; aggregate reached a new branch low of 762.706 us versus parent 765.033 and Trial3 768.666. No additional hosted request was launched.

Applied occupancy-two shared-memory staging to the original 256x256 2-CTA inverse-panel solve, preserving the 4096-row direct-tail crossover and all other kernels. Wrapped build, official tests, fresh-input guard, and full grid passed. Aggregate measured 763.290 us. The direct n8192 cell stayed at 4463.091 us, while n16384/n32768 slowed from the occupancy-one 256x256 policy's 13204.582/40535.527 to 15170.205/50709.370 us, adding 1965.623/10173.843 us and confirming the reduced staging depth costs more as the solve work grows.

Removed the three trailing A22/A23/A33 tasks from the first update node. The middle update now loads those original source tiles, applies the U0 and U1 rank-k terms sequentially in the same FP32 shared accumulator, then factors/stores; this eliminates three intermediate FP32 stores and reloads while preserving arithmetic order and graph dependencies. The first update grid falls from 384 to 192 blocks and the second U1 operands replace U0 operands in the same two shared buffers. Wrapped build, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, exact batch64/n256 checker, and all 15 cells passed. Target measured 67.757 us mean/63.614 best versus Trial19 66.438/62.592; the clean floor moved 1.022 us slower. Aggregate measured 763.787 us. No additional hosted profile request was launched.

Expanded only the original 256x256 2-CTA inverse-panel solve from a 2x1 to 2x2 cluster so TMA multicasts each panel operand across two output-column tiles, preserving occupancy-one staging and the 4096-row direct-tail policy. Wrapped build, validation, fresh-input guard, and full grid passed. Aggregate measured 763.855 us amid unrelated small-cell noise. Direct n8192 measured 4464.069 us; n16384/n32768 measured 13380.685/40927.901 us versus 13204.582/40535.527 for the 2x1 cluster, adding 176.103/392.374 us.

Replaced the validated cuBLAS panel update with an explicit SM100 persistent CuTe dense GEMM: FP16 prior factors are loaded by TMA, multicast across (2,1) clusters, and accumulated by 2-CTA tcgen05 WGMMA into each FP32 supernode in place. Complete triangular emission remains fused with final diagonal-factor copy. Official validation, fresh-input guard, and full grid passed. Aggregate measured 764.013 us; n8192/n16384/n32768 measured 4467.197/14348.911/53222.665 us versus the cuBLAS control's 4461.754/14236.803/51084.202 us, so this first explicit cluster configuration pays most at n32768.

Extended 16-column quarter panels to the middle U12/U13 solve, raising that node from 256 to 512 blocks with 64x16 LD20 TRSM workspaces of 22.00 KiB. Each quarter writes disjoint FP32 output and FP16 sidecar segments before the graph-ordered middle update. Wrapped build, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, exact batch64/n256 checker, and all 15 cells passed. The first full benchmark was systemically degraded across every untouched dispatch (1246.477 us aggregate, target 111.983/104.816), so the active set was repeated once; normal untouched timings returned at 764.361 us aggregate and target 68.513 us mean/64.514 best. The clean target floor was 0.830 us slower than Trial14's 32-column middle solve. No additional hosted profile request was launched.

Combined the measured output policies in one dispatch: n16384 retains the no-source FP32 solve workspace plus fused FP32/FP16 emission, while n32768 stores the no-source solve directly to FP16 and vector-expands to FP32. Both 256x256/2x1 TMA-store kernels are compiled and the 4096-row direct-tail policy is unchanged. Wrapped build, validation, fresh-input guard, and full grid passed. Aggregate measured 764.492 us. n16384 measured 13157.173 us. The n32768 mean was inflated to 41520.603 us by one 283588-us outlier among 108 runs while its best was 39185.410 us, so an identical normalized rerun is warranted.

Shortened the remaining update-loader shared-address lifetimes. FP32 tile and FP16 tile/pair cp.async helpers now convert each destination to one 32-bit shared base before their unrolled loops and form only byte offsets per row, replacing repeated generic-pointer conversions in the profiled update and middle-update nodes. The two-dimensional task grids and scoped metadata from Trials17-18 remain. Wrapped build, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, exact batch64/n256 checker, and all 15 cells passed. Target measured 66.438 us mean/62.592 best, improving the clean floor by 0.634 us over Trial18 and 0.580 us over Trial12's prior branch low of 63.172. Aggregate measured 764.863 us. No additional hosted profile request was launched.

Returned to Trial19's best update path and distributed the initial A00 upper-factor drain across all six half-panel CTAs. Each CTA stores a disjoint round-robin subset of factor float4 vectors while retaining its own panel FP32/FP16 drain, removing task0's unique full-factor tail without changing factorization or dependencies. Wrapped build, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, exact batch64/n256 checker, and all 15 cells passed. Target measured 67.173 us mean/63.596 best, 1.004 us slower than Trial19's 62.592 floor. Aggregate measured 764.866 us. No additional hosted profile request was launched.

Removed the underfilled 64-block initial factor graph node. Each of the three 192-block initial-solve workers per matrix now loads/factorizes tile0,0 locally before TRSM, and worker0 vector-stores the returned diagonal; duplicated factor work trades for greater parallel exposure and one fewer node/dependency. Slice build, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and all 15 cells passed. Batch64/n256 measured 72.023 us mean/68.712 best versus Trial27 71.560/68.480, with one 0.712 ms sample. Aggregate reached a new branch low of 765.033 us versus 765.844.

Extended the fused final solved-panel drain so each thread stores its float4 output and half2 shared operand, then immediately cp.async-prefetches the matching final-diagonal accumulator segment back into the now-dead panel address. One wait/barrier replaces the separate conversion barrier plus accumulator load phase. Slice build, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and all 15 cells passed. Batch64/n256 improved from Trial26 73.525 us mean/69.116 best to 71.560 us mean/68.480 best despite one 0.606 ms sample. Aggregate reached a new branch low of 765.844 us versus 767.908.

Replaced every CTA-wide handoff in the paired 448-thread n128 teams with independent immediate-count named barriers. Barrier1 synchronizes the first 448-thread matrix group and barrier2 the second, so factor, solve, and compensated WMMA phases no longer wait for the sibling matrix; inactive groups still satisfy their own barrier safely. Wrapped build, tests, guard, and full grid passed. n128 improved from 62.509 to 59.629 us, recovering 2.880 us of cross-matrix lockstep overhead and approaching the one-matrix 56.161-us parent while keeping 108 paired CTAs in the 148-block grid. n32/n64 measured 16.379/20.927 us. Aggregate was 766.770 us with an unrelated n256 outlier; larger clean floors were strong.

Isolated the compact n128 16x16 block-tile layout from multi-matrix resource coupling: launch one 448-thread CTA per matrix with only its 36-KiB lower block store, retaining fourteen-warps, named handoffs, float4 packed I/O, and compensated LD16 WMMA. Wrapped build, tests, guard, and full grid passed. n128 reached 55.092 us, improving the dense one-matrix Trial2 result of 56.161 by 1.069 us and the packed-pair Trial14 result of 58.320 by 3.228 us. This measures the packed layout itself as profitable while the second matrix's shared thread/barrier resources caused the remaining pair loss. n32/n64 held 16.381/20.929 us. Aggregate was 766.770 us with an unrelated n256 mean outlier and n2048 tails.

Made the first direct-source batch2/n4096 rank-k legal with a 128x256 two-CTA rectangular schedule, exact two-half triangular coverage, three 128-column accumulator stages within SM100's 512-column allocation, occupancy-two cooperative A/B staging, and D-only MN_SW64 while retaining direct-input factor/solve, factor stagger, 13 independent stages, three-stage batched tail, and every other dispatch. Slice build, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and all 15 cells passed. Aggregate measured 767.806 us; batch2/n4096 measured 1835.222 us with one 23.622-ms outlier and 1719.792 us best versus parent 1767.353/1707.936. Authorized hosted index11 job 8f2e7aa012a145cea88dbfc56f6dea89 ran 2026-07-20T22:17:35Z--22:23:21Z on exact commit 5fab51235d1dccfeb741389aaa060333e14f1a00 (source SHA256 ba933386cd6043b9e62f6cd4fb11568b978d1bbe04b79516531b795e58329206): source rank-k 41.22 us, 46 registers, 115.71 KiB shared, 9.39% achieved occupancy, 78.38% no-eligible cycles, and 2.2x/3.2x shared load/store conflicts. Canonical artifacts are under profiles/2026-07-19-01-44-06-cholesky-resumed-local-unmerged/brief-95-trial-1-5fab512*.

Fused the final solved-panel FP32 output store with its shared FP16 conversion in one float4/half2 C device pass. The 64-block final node now reads the solved panel once and removes one CTA barrier before loading its final diagonal accumulator; vectorized stores, LD72 shared operands, compact sidecar, and co-issued update loads remain fixed. Slice build, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and all 15 cells passed. Batch64/n256 improved from Trial25 75.114 us mean/69.440 best to 73.525 us mean/69.116 best despite one 0.877 ms sample. Aggregate reached a new branch low of 767.908 us.

Completed the standalone initial-factor width sweep at 192 threads, preserving Trial34's dedicated factor operator and original 128-lane cp.async/store mapping while every solve/update node remained unchanged. Wrapped build, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and all 15 cells passed. Batch64/n256 improved over the 256-thread Trial34 from 74.253/70.018 us to 73.356/69.758 us, but remained above the 128-thread Trial27 at 71.560/68.480 us. Aggregate measured 767.976 us. No hosted profile was launched.

Changed the power-of-two LD64 FP16 shared operands to LD72 while retaining packed LD64 sidecar rows and co-issued FP32/FP16 transfers. This preserves non-power-of-two bank spacing and keeps update dynamic shared memory below the original LD80 layout. Slice build, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and all 15 cells passed. Batch64/n256 recovered from Trial23 84.824 us mean/74.880 best to 74.077 us mean/70.140 best despite one 0.814 ms sample. Aggregate reached a new branch low of 768.091 us versus Trial14 768.640.

Widened the one-matrix compact n128 CTA from fourteen/448 to sixteen/512 warps/threads while preserving the 36-KiB block-tile layout and independent immediate-count barrier. Wrapped build, tests, guard, and full grid passed. n128 measured 55.137 us versus Trial15's 55.092, a 0.045-us near-neutral regression: perfect 28-tile early-stage distribution at fourteen warps balances the wider CTA's extra solve coverage. n32/n64 were 16.458/21.116 us. Aggregate measured 768.265 us amid n512/n1024/n2048 drift.

Restored the strongest Trial19 code as the final branch head: LD36 half-panel initial/middle/final solves, scoped update metadata, 2-D sample/task grids, and one-time 32-bit shared bases in the generic update loaders. This exact source was rebuilt and rerun through all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, exact batch64/n256 checker, and all 15 benchmark cells. The confirmation measured 69.625 us mean/62.846 best on the target and 768.297 us aggregate; Trial19 remains the same code's lowest observed floor at 62.592 us. Local profiling is waived and the single granted hosted profile was already consumed at Trial0, so no additional profile request was launched.

Extended Trial13 16-byte cp.async FP32 transfers to the six initial-update accumulators, three middle-update accumulators, and fused-final tile3,3 accumulator; FP32-to-FP16 operand loads and graph topology remain unchanged. Slice build, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and all 15 cells passed. Batch64/n256 improved from Trial13 76.470 us mean/70.910 best to 74.917 us mean/70.912 best; aggregate improved from 771.154 to 768.640 us. The single run-wide hosted profile of exact Trial13 commit 2f94e5f, index3, job fe549f03612c4c688a0466986b1e6e41 ran 2026-07-20T05:15:15Z--05:30:38Z; canonical artifacts show factor 17.41 us, initial/middle solve 20.96/16.06 us, initial/middle update 25.95/22.05 us, and fused final 44.06 us with 86.45 percent no-eligible cycles.

Applied the same shared-address lifetime reduction to the 128-block half-panel final solver: each factor/panel shared base is converted once to 32-bit space and unrolled cp.async rows use byte offsets instead of retaining generic 64-bit pointers. Wrapped build, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and all 15 cells passed. Batch64/n256 measured 75.150 us mean/66.152 best versus Trial2 72.203/66.496 and Trial1's 66.174 floor; aggregate improved from 773.125 to 768.666 us amid faster untouched n512/n1024/n2048 cells. The exact profile's split solve was 12.10 us at 48 registers before this edit; no second hosted request was launched.

Widened each independently synchronized paired n128 team from 448 to 512 threads, restoring sixteen WMMA warps per matrix and a 1024-thread CTA while retaining the mixed 148-block placement and separate named barriers. Wrapped build, tests, guard, and full grid passed. n128 measured 59.724 us versus 59.629 for the fourteen-warp form: extra rank-k distribution was offset by two more warps participating in every group barrier, leaving a 0.095-us near-neutral regression. n32/n64 were 16.451/20.963 us.
